**Issue #2678 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #2678: CI: a patches promotion or log is stuck
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

<!-- stuck #2675 -->
The technical log's pull request https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/2675 (`patches log`, R1369000) has been open over 2 hours and did not merge itself:

- [web (unit 4/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41298645188/job/124827173425)
- [web](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41298645188/job/124827845918)

Until its entries are on main, the 2 commit(s) it logs are missing from the technical log, and nothing logs them again: a later log holds only what went live after it.

Fix it on a branch from main: add the entries this pull request adds to `crates/cards/patches/technical.json` as they are, each after the entry it follows here, and keep main's, each commit once (`cargo jackioh patches check` holds the file's shape). Keep their `version`, the patch that was live when they went live (R1369000): `cargo jackioh patches log` run again would log them on today's. Fix too any check red here that is red on main. Close this issue with that pull request; the watch in `.github/workflows/patches-ship.yml` then closes this one.

If they are red for a reason outside the repository (CI or Render out of minutes, a spending limit, billing, an account, a runner that never started), no change here fixes it: open the plan with a `**Human required:**` line saying what a person must do, and build nothing.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-6` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41308542687)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Get the two entries of the stuck technical-log PR #2675 (`patches log: e121aa8..734e413`, branch `patches/log-734e413`, head `c4c4f2454`) onto `main`. Add them to `crates/cards/patches/technical.json` exactly as #2675 has them: same `version` (`v0.5.10`, R1369000), the same order, the first right after the entry for commit `e121aa8de007e51b503d24233377d5923e89eea6`. Keep every entry `main` already has, and log each commit once. Also fix any check that is red on #2675 and also red on `main`. I found none (see **Risks**), so the change is these 14 lines of data and nothing else. The pull request closes #2678.

## Files to touch

| Path | new/change | What |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/patches/technical.json` | change | Insert two entry objects (commits `e24474d95…`, `734e41346…`) after the entry for commit `e121aa8de…` (`pr: 2669`) |

Do not touch any other file. That includes `apps/web/` (no web fix is needed), every other file in `crates/cards/patches/` (`patches.json`, `shipped.json`, `index.json`, snapshots, `pending/`), `crates/tools/`, `spec/` (no new ruling) and `.github/`, `.harness/`, `bot/`. Do not run `cargo jackioh patches log`. It would log the commits again on today's live patch and would also log commits that #2675 does not cover.

Governing rules: SPEC §10.10 and R1369000 (`spec/rulings/R1369000.md`: what the technical log is, and that an entry keeps the version that was live when it was logged). The shape check is `check_technical` in `crates/tools/src/technical.rs`: each commit once, each `version` one of `patches.json`'s, no `cards` kind, no `pr: 0`, and player lines by R724001.

## Steps

1. **Check that neither commit is already logged.** Run:
   `grep -c -e e24474d95032ada4dd6816075ec1d63ff0fb2b3b -e 734e41346d9cf103b38c3f1d3b32df9b1b0bdb95 crates/cards/patches/technical.json`
   - Expect `0`.
   - If a commit is already in the file (a later log or a rerun of #2675 merged first), leave that entry out in step 2, so that each commit is logged once. If both are there, change nothing and report that the entries are already on `main`.

2. **Insert the entries.** In `crates/cards/patches/technical.json`, find the entry whose `"commit"` is `"e121aa8de007e51b503d24233377d5923e89eea6"` (`"pr": 2669`, `"title": "patches ship: v0.5.9f"`).
   - At the base `734e41346` it is the last entry of the file, at lines 3824–3829.
   - Directly after that entry's closing `}`, add a `,` and then the two objects below, in this order, with 2-space indentation like the rest of the file. Copy them byte for byte, `version` included. Do not change `v0.5.10` to any other version.

   ```json
     {
       "version": "v0.5.10",
       "commit": "e24474d95032ada4dd6816075ec1d63ff0fb2b3b",
       "pr": 2672,
       "title": "patches log: 19fea97..e121aa8",
       "kind": "app"
     },
     {
       "version": "v0.5.10",
       "commit": "734e41346d9cf103b38c3f1d3b32df9b1b0bdb95",
       "pr": 2673,
       "title": "patches ship: v0.5.10",
       "kind": "app"
     }
   ```

   - If `main` has newer entries after `e121aa8de…`, put a `,` after the second object and keep those newer entries after it, unchanged.
   - The file still ends with `]` and a single trailing newline.
   - Do not reformat, re-sort or re-indent anything else.

3. **Check the diff.** Run `git diff -- crates/cards/patches/technical.json`. It must show exactly 14 added lines and no removed lines (`git diff --numstat` prints `14	0`).
   - If the file on `main` is unchanged since `734e41346` (`git diff 734e41346 HEAD -- crates/cards/patches/technical.json` printed nothing before your edit), the result is byte-identical to #2675's file. `sha256sum crates/cards/patches/technical.json` must print `fcdc23ebfe086909938c5fd5112bc40ea97d680b9554d6d545fac56fe465cbc3`.
   - If `origin/patches/log-734e413` is fetched, `git diff origin/patches/log-734e413 -- crates/cards/patches/technical.json` must be empty in that case.

4. **Run the checks** in **Done when**.

## Tests

No new test: the change is data only, and the existing checks hold its shape and how it is read.

- `cargo jackioh patches check`: `check_technical` holds the whole file (each commit once, `v0.5.10` is in `patches.json`, kind `app`, `pr` not 0).
- The web tests that read the real `technical.json`. Both entries have no `player` line, so `technicalLines()` in `apps/web/src/patches/releases.ts` and these tests skip them.
  - Command: `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/patches/PatchNotes.test.tsx src/patches/github.test.ts src/patches/source.test.ts src/wording.test.ts src/static-pages.test.ts`
  - Run `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` first if `apps/web/src/wasm/pkg` is missing.
  - Tests involved:
    - `PatchNotes.test.tsx`: "R1369000 the real log's player lines are on the page under their X" and "R724000 R1369000 the real history opens on its newest line…".
    - `wording.test.ts`: "R724001 R1369000 no player note in patches.json or line of technical.json says…".
    - `github.test.ts`: "GitHub releases of the real history".
- The shard that was red on #2675:
  `pnpm exec vitest run --project web --shard=4/4 --exclude '**/src/audio/**' --exclude '**/src/fx/**' --exclude '**/src/cards/art/convention.test.ts' --exclude '**/src/net/promote-production.test.ts'`
  - Expect 97 files and 1906 tests passing.

## Done when

- [ ] `crates/cards/patches/technical.json` holds both entries, in #2675's order, directly after the `e121aa8de…` entry, with `version` `v0.5.10`.
- [ ] Every entry `main` had is still there and unchanged, and each commit appears once (diff is `14	0`).
- [ ] No other file is changed (`git status --porcelain` lists only `technical.json`; `apps/web/src/wire` is clean).
- [ ] The harness checks pass: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests, web tests.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` passes. `crates/cards/patches/` is kind App with no card change, so it needs no pending fragment, as the earlier technical-log fixes #2296, #2408 and #2585 needed none.
- [ ] The shard 4/4 command under **Tests** passes.
- [ ] The pull request body says `Closes #2678`.

## Risks

- **Duplicate or lost entries.** If another log PR merges first, a blind copy of #2675's file would drop its entries, and a blind append could log a commit twice. Steps 1–3 guard against both, and `patches check` fails on a duplicate.
- **Wrong version.** If `patches log` were re-run, the entries would go on whatever patch is live then. Copy the JSON instead (R1369000).
- **Why the shard was red on #2675.** I could not read the CI log: there is no GitHub access here. I reproduced the shard locally instead, on a 4-CPU machine with both WASM modules built, using CI's own shard 4/4 command with `--reporter=verbose`:
  - On `main` at `734e41346`: 97 files and 1906 tests passed (about 136 s).
  - On #2675's head `c4c4f2454`: the same 97 files and 1906 tests passed.
  - The patches, static-pages and wording test files passed on both.

  The only difference between the two trees is the two entries. They have no `player` line, so no web code or test reads them. Billing or minutes would have failed every job, not one shard of four. So it looks like a timing flake under CI load. Shard 4 has had such races before: the `almanac.test.tsx` R654 race, fixed in #2407, and `shortcuts.test.tsx` R2126000.
  - Do not weaken anything to get green: no `.skip`, no raised timeout.
  - If this pull request's `web (unit 4/4)` is red on a revision round, run the named test file locally on `main`.
    - If it fails on `main` too, fix that test or its code, as #2585 fixed `apps/web/src/patches/diff.ts`.
    - If it is a race in the test, an added `waitFor` on the same assertion with the file's existing `SLOW` timeout is the honest fix. Report it with the test's name.
- **Determinism, replay, hidden information:** not affected. No engine, card or client code changes, and the catalog version stays the same.

## Open questions

- None block the build. One for a person: if `web (unit 4/4)` fails on this pull request with the same test that failed on #2675, that test is red on `main` or flaky in CI's environment. Someone who can open the CI log (run 41298645188, job 124827173425) should name the test so it can be fixed. The runs here cannot see it.
<!-- /jackioh-bot:plan -->
````
